evidence.reason: `schema_problem` documents fail-closed diagnostics rather than exceptions, but lines 1087-1089 index `_SCHEMA_TYPES` directly. A schema rule using an unknown type name such as `"number"` raises `KeyError` instead of returning an unsupported-schema diagnostic, so a sampled receipt can lose the verdict and tick result. This is a routine correctness defect; the smallest fix is to check the type name against `_SCHEMA_TYPES` and return an unsupported-schema problem.
